title: Implement permutation generation (backtracking) in Go
description: Greenfield Go task: implement Permutations(nums []int) [][]int that returns all permutations of nums using backtracking with swap-based generation.

required_artifacts: Works on a copy of the input slice
Backtracking via swap at position start, recurse start+1, swap back
Collects permutations by copying nums when start==len
followup_prompts: Run `go test ./...` and show me which tests are passing and which are still failing. Fix any failures — pay attention to edge cases like empty input, boundary values, and error conditions.
Final check: run `go test ./...` one more time. All tests must be green. If anything is still failing, trace through the failing assertion and fix it now.
